definitions.explanation: The early part of the day.

examples.english: To wake up in the morning.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べる。

notes:
{朝|あさ} means morning.

TIMES OF DAY:
- {朝|あさ}: morning
- {昼|ひる}: noon/day
- {夕方|ゆうがた}: evening
- {夜|よる}: night

COMPOUNDS:
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}: breakfast
- {毎朝|まいあさ}: every morning
- {今朝|けさ}: this morning
- {朝日|あさひ}: morning sun
